paper_metadata.title: Predictors and Underlying Causes of Medically Intractable Localization-Related Epilepsy in Childhood

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study clearly defines inclusion criteria and the recruitment setting (tertiary center). However, as a hospital-based study in a specialized center, there is inherent selection bias toward more severe cases, which the authors acknowledge. The participation rate of eligible individuals is not explicitly stated, making it difficult to rule out selection bias within the sampling frame.
